tech.title: Technology Stack
tech.subtitle: CrewOps is built with a modern, robust stack of technologies ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability

backend.title: Backend
backend.spring: Spring Boot for building the core application with Spring Security, JPA, and validation mechanisms
backend.hibernate: Hibernate ORM for efficient database access and object-relational mapping
backend.rest: RESTful APIs with comprehensive documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.thymeleaf: Thymeleaf templates for server-side rendering and dynamic HTML generation
frontend.bootstrap: Bootstrap for responsive and modern UI design
frontend.vanillaJs: Vanilla JavaScript for interactive components and enhanced user experience

database.title: Database
database.postgresql: PostgreSQL as the main relational database for storing all operational data
database.h2: H2 Database for testing and development purposes

devops.title: DevOps & Tools
devops.docker: Docker containers for deployment and environment consistency
devops.maven: Maven for project build and dependency management
devops.git: Git for version control with GitHub repository hosting

testing.title: Testing
testing.mockito: Mockito for mocking and testing service layers
testing.integration: Comprehensive integration tests covering critical application flows
